title: Add and Subtract Decimals
objective: I can add and subtract decimals by lining up the place values and the decimal points.
model: vertical addition and subtraction with the decimal points lined up in place-value columns and zeros annexed

widgets.root: Scanned 200 seeds per level: no duplicate or equivalent choice, one right answer; distractors include the 7.188 misplaced-point result and the 44.52 wrong-operation result.

The act asks 'Place a point at 1.5. Tap or drag on the number line': it tests the size of a decimal, not lining up place values to add or subtract. It does not mirror the objective ('line up the place values and the decimal points') and no step of the add/subtract algorithm is manipulated.
widgets.replacement: Add a new act (assets/studio-act/decimalcols.js, kind 'decimalcols', mode 'addsub'): a vertical-arithmetic board with fixed columns tens | ones | decimal point | tenths | hundredths | thousandths. The student drags each addend's digits into the grid (the point column is fixed, so the point lands in place), taps an empty cell to annex a grey 0, then fills the answer column by column from the right with a carry/regroup box above each column. L1 same number of places; L2 different places (annex a zero); L3 subtraction with regrouping across a zero (12.5 − 3.45, 30 − 12.75); L4 error trap: a pre-set board with the addends right-aligned (6.4 over 2.35, the 4 under the 5) that the student must repair by sliding one addend. Grade the alignment (every point in the point column) and then the sum; name the right-edge-alignment misconception ('you lined up the last digits, not the points') and the missing-annexed-zero misconception ('a gap is not a 0'). Text bilingual like the other acts.
